purpose: Live end-to-end AWS Bedrock synthesiser evaluation

metric_definitions.token_cost: Bedrock-reported tokens and estimated USD using recorded per-million-token rates.
metric_definitions.loop_discipline: Run terminates without exceeding its configured retry budget.
metric_definitions.task_completion_rate: Cases ending in their expected terminal status.
metric_definitions.interpretation_accuracy: Exact checks of labelled categorical fields in the structured interpretation.
metric_definitions.semantic_equivalence: Independent model judgement against expected meaning and safety requirements.
metric_definitions.verifier_false_pass: Final verifier returned PASS although the independent semantic judgement failed.
metric_definitions.schema_validation_pass_rate: Produced agent artifacts accepted by their Pydantic schema; verifier fallbacks fail.
